title: Verify PR Pre-Script Input
description: Pre-fetched task data written by the pre_script and mounted into the sandbox. The skill reads this instead of calling the issue tracker or GitHub APIs directly.

description.description: Task description in the issue tracker's native format (e.g., ADF for Jira)

pr_url.description: PR URL extracted from the task, or empty if not linked

github.description: GitHub tier-1 read bundle, prefetched on the trusted runner (where GH_TOKEN lives) so the sandbox needs no api.github.com egress. Every read the verify-pr skill performs against the PR is captured here.

headRefName.description: PR head branch name (gh pr view --json headRefName)

commit_sha.description: OID of the PR head ref tip commit (gh pr view --json headRefOid --jq .headRefOid)

stat.description: PR diffstat (git apply --stat on the fetched pr.diff; gh pr diff has no --stat flag)

review_comments.description: PR review (inline code) comments (gh api repos/<repo>/pulls/<n>/comments)

idempotency.description: Related-issue metadata prefetched on the trusted runner so the sandbox can run the Steps 6d/6f/7c idempotency checks (duplicate sub-task and root-cause detection) without a Jira token or egress. Always present in a valid prefetch: the producer runs on the trusted runner with a Jira token, so it can always emit the bundle — with an empty related_issues array when the task has no sub-tasks or linked issues yet. Requiring it (rather than leaving it optional) closes the gap that let a schema-valid prefetch omit the bundle and silently skip dedup in the tokenless sandbox.

related_issues.description: The task's existing sub-tasks and linked issues (e.g., root-cause tasks), each with the fields the dedup checks inspect.

description.description: Issue description in the tracker's native format (e.g., ADF)

comments.description: Comment bodies in the tracker's native format; searched by Step 7c for the root-cause marker.

source.description: Raw issue tracker response for fields not captured above
